content: Job ni a khenae hnin thoe a bo

content.text: Hathnukkhu, Job ni a pahni dawk hoi a khenae hnin hah thoe a bo.
Job ni ati e teh,
ka khenae hnin hah kahmat pawiteh,
capa a vawn ati e tangmin hai kahmat pawiteh,
Hatnae hnin hah hmonae lah awm pawiteh,
Cathut ni lathueng lahoi khen hanh naseh.
Hoehpawiteh, angnae ang hanh naseh.
Hmonae hoi duenae tâhlip ni ramuk naseh,
tâmai ni ramuk e, kanîthun e hmonae ni pakhi naseh.
Hatnae tangmin hah hmonae ni kuen naseh,
hatnae kum dawk e hninnaw dawkvah lunghawi van hanh naseh.
Thapa touknae dawk hai bawk hanh naseh.
Oe, hatnae tangmin hah kingkadi e tangmin lah awm pawiteh,
lunghawinae kamthang pai hanh naseh.
Tuitam thaw sak hane coungkacoe kaawmnaw ni, hatnae hnin hah,
thoekâbonaw ni thoebo awh naseh.
Hatnae tangmin amom lae âsi hah mawm naseh,
angnae hah tawng awh naseh. Hateiteh, hmawt awh hanh naseh.
Kanî a tâco e hai, hmawt hanh naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, anu e thun hah khan hoeh eiteh,
ka mithmu vah, ka lungmathoenae hah kâhrawk hoeh.
Bangkongmaw ka tâco tahma vah, ka due hoeh va.
Bangkongmaw von dawk hoi ka tâco nah, kahmakata hoeh va.
Bangkongmaw phai dawk tawm e lah ka o,
bangkongmaw ka nei hane sanutui na pânei.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka i vaiteh, karoumcalah ka o han ei,
mat ka i vaiteh, ka kâhat hane boum.
Talai siangpahrang hoi khokhangkungnaw,
ka rawk e bout ka kangdout sakkungnaw hoi vah,
hoehpawiteh, sui ka tawn e tami ka lentoe e,
a im dawk ngun hoi kakawi sak naw hoi vah,
hoehpawiteh, thakoup hoehnahlan ka khe e camo,
angnae kahmawt boihoeh e, camo patetlah, kapawk e lah ka o hoeh va.
Hawvah tamikathoutnaw ni, runae a sak e hah a kâhat awh teh,
hawvah thakatawnnaw hah a kâhat awh.
Hawvah thongkabawt e cungtalah a kâhat awh teh,
repcoungroe pawlawk hai thai hoeh toe.
Hawvah tami kathoung kalen naw cungtalah ao awh teh,
a sannaw hah a bawi koehoi a hlout.
Bangkongmaw runae ka khang e koevah, angnae poe e lah ao teh,
bangdawkmaw a lung ka mathout e koe hringnae hah poe e lah ao.
Due han a ngai poung, hateiteh, tho hoeh.
Pakawp e râw hlak vah, hoe ka pataw e ka tawng e,
phuen a hmu awh navah,
dei thai hoeh e a lung kahawi katang e koevah,
bangdawkmaw a lamthung hro lah kaawm e koevah,
angnae hah poe e lah ao. Cathut ni rapan hoi kalupsin e koevah,
Bangkongtetpawiteh, rawca yueng lah ka cingou teh
ka khuikanae mitphi hai tui ka lawng e palang patetlah doeh ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka takipoung e hah,
ka tak dawk a pha teh, ka ngaihri poung e ni na thosin.
Ka phunep hoeh dawk duem kaawm thai hoeh.
Kâhat panuek hoeh, bangkongtetpawiteh, rucatnae ni a pha telah ati.
